title: O Que Ninguém Vê
summary: Saturday 2027-01-30. Tarik runs his first full Academy Green day and the first of four private Counter-Strike scrims (Main beat an independent group 13-8 on Nuke and lose 11-13 on Train; Academy lose 11-13 on Overpass and win 13-10 on Cobblestone). Arthur Fletcher watches the Main train. Zayn asks Maya Torres and Evelyn Park for a private conversation about how he processes sudden changes; no diagnosis is made. Adrian and Maya begin discussing supervised animal visits at the campus.
keyEvents: 8:17 — Tarik's first full Academy Green session: he tells Evan the problem in a lost Overpass round may have been the information he received, not his call; he presents the seven competitive maps (Cobblestone, Inferno, Nuke, Overpass, Dust II, Train, Cache) and Zayn names Train as favourite and Dust II as least liked.
9:32 — Main prepare for CCT North America #1 (Austin, from 2027-02-08) after watching NRG, Imperial and HEROIC; Mold wants to face Stewie2K's team.
9:48 — Private scrim, Main vs an independent North American group, Nuke: Kairos Gaming win 13-8 (8-4 at half).
11:16 — Private scrim, Academy Green vs another independent five, Overpass: the Academy lose 13-11 (7-5 for the opponent at half); Zayn's correct reads are not communicated in time.
12:38 — Arthur Fletcher, living in the campus residential area since moving from Mackenzie months earlier, talks with Owen about the CCT trip; he tells Owen to go to Austin thinking about his work.

13:46 — Zayn meets Maya Torres and Evelyn Park privately; the content is confidential, no diagnosis is made, an assessment is offered with family consent because he is a minor, and no update is made to his competitive profile or sent to Tarik, Luk or Adrian.
14:52 — Private scrim, Main vs the same independent group, Train: Kairos Gaming lose 13-11 after Owen wins a 1v2 clutch (6-6 at half, 11-11); Arthur watches from the observation area.
16:08 — Private scrim, Academy Green vs the independent group on Cobblestone: the Academy win 13-10 (6-6 at half); Zayn shares a hypothesis without waiting for certainty and Tarik gets his first win.

18:17 — Adrian asks Maya about bringing animals to the campus: supervised visits with a partner organisation first, no permanent residents and no kennel decided; Maya will assess viability with Evelyn and administration.
22:13 — Luk, Tarik and Trace review the four scrims; no official result, ranking or statistic changes; nine days remain before the CCT.
consequences: Tarik starts working with the Academy Green; Zayn is asked to communicate hypotheses without waiting for certainty and Evan to separate confirmed information from hypotheses.
Adrian asks Maya Torres and Evelyn Park to assess the viability of supervised animal visits; nothing is approved.
canonIntroduced: Four private Counter-Strike scrims are played on 2027-01-30 (see data/matches).
Adrian begins studying supervised animal visits at the campus (feasibility only).
continuityNotes: Opponents of the four scrims are unnamed independent groups; the Main opponent is described as one group of North American players who train together and have minor-tournament experience, the Academy opponent as another group of high-ranked queue players.
Zayn's private conversation is deliberately confidential; no diagnosis exists and none should be stated on any public page.
The scrim table in the episode lists the opponents only as 'Kairos Gaming' and 'Academy Green' with maps and scores.
confirmedFacts: Main: Nuke win 13-8; Train loss 11-13. Academy Green: Overpass loss 11-13; Cobblestone win 13-10. All four are private, unofficial and affect no ranking.
Kairos Gaming's CCT participation is confirmed; the Academy has no official debut defined.
Arthur Fletcher moved from Mackenzie to Los Angeles months earlier and lives in the campus residential area; his chemotherapy had positive responses but treatment and follow-up continue.
Zayn plays lurker; Evan IGL, Milo entry, Nolan AWP, Reid anchor; no role changes.
Adrian has invested in common areas, recreation, psychological support and spaces for interests outside games.
unconfirmedDetails: Names of the independent opponents, any contract or date for an animal programme, and any outcome of Zayn's conversation beyond a possible later appointment.
notes: Kairos Gaming is the public name of the Counter-Strike Main team.
